title: Is Israel Dividing Fox with Trump?
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's** 'Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the
right-wing industrial outrage complex and Bari World. In tonight's edition, we
look at how Trump's 'Fox News Cabinet' is bent out of shape over the president
"capitulating" to Iran and turning its back on Israel. Plus, is Tony Dokoupil
trying to rehab his image by distancing himself from Bari Weiss? Also, what
does the CBS News ombudsman actually DO at the network?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

* * *

# **Turning on Trump?**

**Donald Trump 's** ['Fox News Cabinet,'](https://zeteo.com/p/how-the-fox-
news-cabinet-helped-jumpstart) which gleefully pushed the administration to
join Israel in launching [its doomed and illegal
war](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-war-doomed-from-start) against Iran, is
now beside itself that the president is desperately backing out of the fight
by signing a[ "weak"](https://www.nydailynews.com/2026/06/21/trumps-iran-
bluster-ends-with-a-weak-whimper/) peace agreement that [reveals without a
shred of doubt](https://www.theatlantic.com/national-security/2026/06/trump-
defeat-iran-war/687566/) that the United States lost.
